summary: validate_implementation.py defines repository-root validation; requires five specific acceptance-toolchain files (policy, projection script, prerequisite schema, two tests); runs six registered Python test/validation commands sequentially; missing files yield implementation-not-present failure; nonzero command yields registered-command-failed with recent output; all successful commands yield implementation-complete pass; pass authorizes implementation-complete only, explicitly not acceptance-passed, release, or archived; uses Windows py launcher and an absolute quick_validate.py path.
